answer_2.quote: We evaluate MAGICORE on seven reasoning datasets ... and report accuracy as the primary performance metric.

answer_3.quote: We incorporate three types of models: (1) an LLM interchangeably performing three roles..., (2) an Outcome Reward Model (ORM) for generating global, solution-level correctness score, and (3) a Process Reward Model (PRM) for generating local step-by-step correctness scores.
